title: Transaction Draft
description: Canonical transaction draft produced by the parser. The AI drafts, it never executes. Optional fields are omitted, never null. Not expressible here (enforced by the Pydantic model only): expires_at must be after created_at.

money.$comment: The 'not' clause exists because Python's re treats '$' as matching before a final newline; ECMA-262 does not. Together they reject '50.00\n' in every implementation.

utc_timestamp.$comment: UTC, whole seconds, Z suffix. See $defs/money for why the 'not' clause exists.

display_name.description: Human-readable payee name shown to the user.

id.description: Globally unique draft identifier (UUID). Stable across runs for a given draft.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp the draft was created, e.g. 2026-10-03T10:00:00Z.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp after which the draft is stale and must not be signed. Must be after created_at.

nonce.description: Server-generated random value, unique per draft. Anti-replay only: it makes two otherwise identical drafts hash differently. NOT an idempotency key.

intent_type.description: What the user wants to do.

source_account.description: The account money leaves or shares are bought from.

amount.description: The monetary amount. Always a decimal string — never a float.

value.description: Decimal string, e.g. "50.00". ASCII digits, no leading zeros, exactly two decimals.

confidence.description: Parser confidence in the draft, 0.0 to 1.0 inclusive. Excluded from the hash.

unresolved.description: Field names the parser could not resolve. If non-empty, the draft cannot be signed or executed.

transcript.description: The raw user text the draft was produced from. Treated as data, never instructions.

payee.description: Beneficiary for transfer or bill_payment intents. Omitted (never null) when payee is unresolved.

payee_candidates.description: Candidate payees. Required with at least 2 entries when 'payee' is in unresolved; otherwise absent or empty.

ticker.description: Stock/equity ticker symbol for equity_purchase intents.

quantity.description: Number of shares for equity_purchase. Present when order is share-based.

notional_amount.description: Target dollar amount for equity_purchase when order is amount-based. Decimal string.

order_type.description: Order type for equity_purchase: market or limit.

allOf.$comment: transfer / bill_payment need a payee unless 'payee' is unresolved.
A payee cannot coexist with 'payee' in unresolved.
payee_candidates: at least 2 when 'payee' is unresolved, otherwise absent or empty.
